race.comment: CHALKNCHEDDAR (5) was out of the money two back at Melton. Turned in a better run last time out when third over 1750m at Swan Hill, beaten 10 metres. Has the talent to take care of this field. DIAMOND KRUSHER (6) ran fourth last start at this track over 2190m, beaten 14 metres. Expect her to pose a serious challenge. BOHEMIAN BRAIDS (7) disappointed last time when seventh over 1750m at Swan Hill. Can make amends. BEARTASTIC WRITER (1) is the best of the rest after finishing sixth first-up over 2190m at this track last time out.
